Admissions Process

Take the next step in your leadership journey. Explore the admission requirements and follow the application process to join the Executive MBA programme at TEAM University in partnership with Kozminski University.

Apply online Book a consultation
Who Can Apply?
Requirement 01
Management Experience

At least 5 years of management experience in a senior

Requirement 02
Academic Qualification

A Bachelor's degree from a recognised higher education institution.

Processing Timelines
01
Submit Your Documents

Provide the required application documents for review by our admissions committee.

02
Formal Requirements Check

The admissions team checks whether you meet the programme's eligibility requirements.

03
Admissions Interview

Meet with the admissions committee to discuss your professional experience, leadership for joining the programme.

04
Mathematics & Logic Test

Complete the mathematics and logic assessment as part of the admission process.

05
Admission Decision

Receive official written notification of the admissions committee's decision.

06
Sign the Contract

Complete the enrolment process by signing the programme contract and paying tuition fees.

Corporate Sponsorship

Invest in Your Leaders. Strengthen Your Business. Companies can sponsor the Executive MBA programme for their managers, supporting leadership development, strategic thinking and long-term business growth.

Book a consultation
How Corporate Sponsorship Works
01
Contact Our Team

Discuss your company's training objectives and identify suitable candidates for the Executive MBA.

02
Discuss the Arrangement

Review sponsorship conditions, payment options and the number of sponsored participants with the programme team.

03
Confirm the Agreement

Finalise the sponsorship terms and required documentation with the university.

04
Begin the Programme

Your nominated managers proceed with the admission process and, once accepted, begin their Executive MBA journey.
